sn35.166:1.3: Kathaṃ nu kho bhante jānato katham passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyatīti || || 4-9
sn35.166:1.4: Cakkhum kho bhikkhu dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati ||
sn35.166:1.5: rūpe dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati ||
sn35.166:1.6: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati ||
sn35.166:1.7: cakkhusamphassaṃ dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati || la ||
sn35.166:1.8: Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukkhaṃ vā || tam pi dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati || || 10
sn35.166:1.9: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evam passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyatīti || || 2-3
